title: Reading the Formal -ra: el que fuera presidente
goal: Recognise a -ra form that has the value of a past indicative in formal and journalistic prose.
grammar: The formal -ra with the value of a past indicative (recognition)

items: I can recognise a -ra form used like a past indicative, as in el que fuera presidente.
I can tell it from the -ra of a wish, a condition or a request.
I can use the new words for news and history.
